subject: Probability and Statistics
chapters: Chapter 4: Sampling Distributions & Central Limit Theorem
Chapter 6: Simple & Multiple Linear Regression, Correlation Analysis

questions.text: State Axioms of Probability. State and prove Bayes' Theorem. A manufacturing plant has three machines $M_1, M_2, M_3$ producing $20\%, 30\%$, and $50\%$ of total items. Defective rates are $1\%, 2\%, 3\%$. An item selected at random is found defective. Find the probability it was produced by machine $M_3$.

Define Probability Density Function (PDF) $f(x)$ and Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) $F(x)$. A continuous random variable $X$ has PDF $f(x) = k x(2-x)$ for $0 \le x \le 2$. Find: (a) Constant $k$, (b) Mean $\mu = E[X]$, (c) Variance $\sigma^2 = \text{Var}(X)$, and (d) $P(0.5 \le X \le 1.5)$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Sampling Distributions & Central Limit Theorem
questions.text: State the conditions for Binomial Distribution ($P(X=x) = \binom{n}{x}p^x q^{n-x}$). Derive its Mean ($\mu = np$) and Variance ($\sigma^2 = npq$). Show that Poisson distribution is the limiting form of binomial distribution when $n \to \infty, p \to 0$ such that $np = \lambda$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Sampling Distributions & Central Limit Theorem
questions.text: Explain the Standard Normal Distribution ( = \frac{X-\mu}{\sigma} \sim N(0, 1)$). The compressive strength of concrete cubes is normally distributed with mean $\mu = 25\,\text{MPa}$ and standard deviation $\sigma = 3.5\,\text{MPa}$. Find the percentage of cubes with compressive strength: (a) Greater than $30\,\text{MPa}$, (b) Less than $20\,\text{MPa}$, and (c) Between $22\,\text{MPa}$ and $28\,\text{MPa}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Simple & Multiple Linear Regression, Correlation Analysis
questions.text: Define Karl Pearson's Coefficient of Correlation ($r = \frac{\text{Cov}(X, Y)}{\sigma_x \sigma_y}$). Derive the equations of the two regression lines: $Y$ on $X$ ($y - \bar{y} = b_{yx}(x - \bar{x})$) and $X$ on $Y$ ($x - \bar{x} = b_{xy}(y - \bar{y})$). Prove that $r = \pm\sqrt{b_{yx} b_{xy}}$ and $|r| \le 1$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Sampling Distributions & Central Limit Theorem
questions.text: State the Central Limit Theorem (CLT). Explain Sampling Distributions of Sample Mean $\bar{X}$ and Sample Proportion $\hat{p}$. Differentiate between Point Estimation and Interval Estimation. Construct a $95\%$ confidence interval for the population mean $\mu$ for large and small samples.

Explain Type I Error ($\alpha$), Type II Error ($\beta$), Level of Significance, Critical Region, and $p$-value in hypothesis testing. Conduct a two-sample Student's $t$-test to determine if there is a significant difference between mean tensile strengths of steel bars produced by two different manufacturing processes at $5\%$ significance level.

Explain Chi-Square Test for: (a) Goodness of Fit ($\chi^2 = \sum \frac{(O_i - E_i)^2}{E_i}$ with $\nu = k - 1 - m$ degrees of freedom), and (b) Independence of Attributes in a $2 \times 2$ contingency table with Yates' continuity correction.

Explain One-Way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA). Formulate the ANOVA table showing Between-Groups and Within-Groups Sum of Squares ($SSB, SSW$), degrees of freedom, Mean Squares ($MSB, MSW$), and $F$-statistic.
